cards.original_question: Susceptanţa unui circuit de curent alternativ sinusoidal este inversul:
cards.previous_ABC_rationales_UNCHANGED: A: 1/Z is admittance Y, not susceptance B; B: 1/R in simple case is conductance, not susceptance; C: B is not strictly 1/X for generic R≠0; for pure reactance R=0, B=-1/X with sign.
cards.source_scope_verdict: Stored C is not universally the reciprocal of reactance; Y=1/(R+jX)=R/(R²+X²)-jX/(R²+X²), thus Bsus=-X/(R²+X²).
cards.option_and_context_check: Pure reactive R=0 still Bsus=-1/X using signed reactance. A is total admittance Y; B is conductance only for pure R.
cards.unresolved_gate: Do not auto-replace G1/G2 imported keys.

cards.previous_ABC_rationales_UNCHANGED: A: fuses do not limit voltage; B: fuses interrupt fault/overload currents according to time-current curve, and some types limit prospective peaks, not prevent instant current rise; C: do not act on undercurrent.
cards.source_scope_verdict: B is intended overcurrent-protection category, but a fuse interrupts an overcurrent after time/current-dependent melting and does not physically stop the initial rise above its threshold.
cards.option_and_context_check: A concerns overvoltage and C undercurrent, neither the fuse's general protective function. Manufacturer explains clearing time and time-current curves.

cards.original_question: Mărimea adimensională care reprezintă variaţia pe care o suferă amplitudinea şi faza undei de tensiune sau curent când parcurge 1 km de linie (lungă ) se numeşte:
cards.previous_ABC_rationales_UNCHANGED: A: propagation constant is correct term, but it is inverse length not dimensionless as stem states; B: attenuation constant α covers amplitude only, not phase; C: distortion constant not the standard α+jβ term.
cards.source_scope_verdict: Imported A names the intended parameter but calling gamma dimensionless is false: gamma=alpha+j beta is reciprocal length. gamma*l is dimensionless.
cards.option_and_context_check: B alpha only amplitude, lacks phase beta. C is not standard joint amplitude-phase propagation parameter. G1-ELE-152 separately has same concept without the erroneous 'adimensională' qualifier.
cards.unresolved_gate: Versioned contrast with G1-ELE-152 is evidence of wording defect, not proof of altered official key.

cards.original_question: În cazul apariţiei fenomenului de rezonanţă într-un circuit de curent alternativ, alimentat de la o sursă, aceasta furnizează circuitului:

cards.source_scope_verdict: A: at sinusoidal steady-state resonance XL=XC so net reactive power from source vanishes; with dissipative R>0 source supplies active energy.
